body.content:
apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
kind: System
metadata:
  namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
  name: reference-loop
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Explore a normalized process response, tune the setpoint and 
    compare measured reference observations.
  provenance:
    source: urn:xverse:studio:reference
    revision: 1.0.0
    maturity: prototype
    limitations:
    - Owned executable reference only; no external simulator, device or 
      scientific fidelity claim.
spec:
  nodes:
  - id: controller-node
    roles:
    - controller
  - id: plant-node
    roles:
    - plant
  - id: observer-node
    roles:
    - observer
  componentInstances:
  - id: controller
    componentRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: Component
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
      name: reference-controller
    nodeId: controller-node
  - id: plant
    componentRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: Component
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
      name: reference-plant
    nodeId: plant-node
  interfaces:
  - id: command
    direction: bidirectional
    payloadSchema: urn:xverse:studio:normalized-scalar:v1
    unitSemantics: '1'
    compatibility: exact
  - id: state
    direction: bidirectional
    payloadSchema: urn:xverse:studio:normalized-scalar:v1
    unitSemantics: '1'
    compatibility: exact
  endpoints:
  - id: controller-out
    ownerId: controller
    interfaceId: command
    direction: output
  - id: plant-in
    ownerId: plant
    interfaceId: command
    direction: input
  - id: plant-out
    ownerId: plant
    interfaceId: state
    direction: output
  - id: observer-in
    ownerId: observer-node
    interfaceId: state
    direction: input
  flows:
  - id: command-flow
    sourceEndpointId: controller-out
    destinationEndpointIds:
    - plant-in
    interfaceId: command
    deliveryIntent: ordered
    timeDomainId: simulation-time
  - id: state-flow
    sourceEndpointId: plant-out
    destinationEndpointIds:
    - observer-in
    interfaceId: state
    deliveryIntent: ordered
    timeDomainId: simulation-time
  timeDomains:
  - id: simulation-time
    clockClass: simulation
    epoch: '0'
    rate: '1'
    monotonic: true
  defaultTimeDomainId: simulation-time
